data.name: Reprise.Aide.Titre
data.value: Data import: one row per packaging (unit, pack, carton, bag, pallet).

data.name: Reprise.Aide.Ligne
data.value: Columns are read in order: do not move them. The first row (headers) is ignored.

data.name: Reprise.Aide.Unite
data.value: Each item has exactly one row at level "Unite" (contains 1): it carries the label, the stock unit (smallest unit sold: piece, kg, litre…), the decimals (0 by the piece, up to 3 by weight or volume) and the purchase cost.

data.name: Reprise.Aide.Autres
data.value: Other rows with the same item code describe its packagings: name (e.g. Carton of 24), level (Pack, Carton, Sac, Palette) and contents in stock units.

data.name: Reprise.Aide.Codes
data.value: Optional barcode: EAN-13, EAN-8 or UPC-A with a correct check digit, unique in the file and in the application.

data.name: Reprise.Aide.Prix
data.value: Selling price incl. VAT in XAF, optional, per packaging: a carton may cost less than its units.

data.name: Reprise.Aide.Cout
data.value: Unit purchase cost excluding recoverable VAT, landing costs included, in XAF per stock unit: it values the stock counted in the opening stock count.

data.name: Reprise.Aide.Import
data.value: The application checks the whole file before importing; nothing is imported while any row has an error. The import creates the opening stock count to be counted.

data.name: Reprise.FichierIllisible
data.value: Unreadable file: send an Excel workbook (.xlsx).

data.name: Reprise.FichierVide
data.value: The file contains no item rows.

data.name: Reprise.FichierTropGros
data.value: Too many rows in the file.

data.name: Reprise.ChampObligatoire
data.value: Required value missing.

data.name: Reprise.TexteTropLong
data.value: Text too long.

data.name: Reprise.NombreInvalide
data.value: Invalid number.

data.name: Reprise.DecimalesInvalides
data.value: Decimals must be 0, 1, 2 or 3.

data.name: Reprise.NiveauInvalide
data.value: Unknown level: Unite, Pack, Carton, Sac or Palette.

data.name: Reprise.ContenuInvalide
data.value: Invalid contents: positive, whole for an item sold by the piece, 1 for the Unite row.

data.name: Reprise.LigneUniteManquante
data.value: This item has no row at level Unite.

data.name: Reprise.LigneUniteEnDouble
data.value: This item has several rows at level Unite.

data.name: Reprise.IncoherenceArticle
data.value: Value differs from the item's Unite row.

data.name: Reprise.CodeArticleExistant
data.value: This item code already exists in the application.

data.name: Reprise.CodeBarresInvalide
data.value: Invalid barcode (EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, check digit).

data.name: Reprise.CodeBarresEnDouble
data.value: Barcode appears several times in the file.

data.name: Reprise.CodeBarresAttribue
data.value: Barcode already assigned in the application.

data.name: Reprise.PrixInvalide
data.value: Invalid selling price (greater than zero).

data.name: Reprise.CoutInvalide
data.value: Invalid purchase cost (zero or positive).

data.name: Reprise.EcritureRefusee
data.value: Import refused: nothing was recorded.
